title: Summit Status Awards Bought with Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Points: Tier Terms
content:
**Reference card.** Under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements, company points may buy a Summit tier in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program for a roster traveler only on a tier where status awards are available. The card lists, per agreement tier, whether status awards are available, the Summit Silver and Summit Gold status-award points, the validity of a status award in calendar months from the award date, and the most status awards redeemed in one agreement year.

| Agreement tier | Status awards available | Summit Silver status-award points | Summit Gold status-award points | Validity (calendar months from the award date) | Most status awards per agreement year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | no | 2200 | 3800 | 12 | 0 |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | no | 2200 | 3800 | 12 | 0 |
| Crestline Corporate Select | yes | 2200 | 3800 | 12 | 2 |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | yes | 2200 | 3800 | 12 | 5 |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | yes | 2200 | 3800 | 12 | 10 |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | yes | 2200 | 3800 | 12 | 20 |

### Points of judgement

- On Crestline Business Connect and Crestline Business Connect Plus status awards are not available, and their yearly limit is 0.
- The status-award points and the validity of 12 calendar months are the same on every tier where status awards are available; only the yearly limit differs, from 2 on Crestline Corporate Select to 20 on Crestline Corporate Strategic.
- A hypothetical Crestline Corporate Preferred agreement that has redeemed 5 status awards in the current agreement year has reached its yearly limit of 5.
